descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: in-flight switch bleed.

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S26 No bleed between patients or contexts: a Save & Extract still in flight while the physician switches to the Nursing Home resident

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on … (UAT TC-19; TFA-92597 What; TFA-92597 AC 3)
  • U12 Nursing Home has its own Medications panel, filled from the pre-round (PR #56). (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 AC 3)
  • U19 Never invent: no tracker row, pre-round output or note contains a drug, indication, unit or status that was not dictated or stored, and none narrates documentation status ('dose not specified in dict … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8)
  • U22 A medication change is never silently lost: if medication extraction or the pre-round parse fails, the typed or dictated text is kept, the rows stay as they were and a clear message says what failed; … (UAT 3.5 (retry, backup model or a clear message; the physician taps Generate and can move to the next patient); UAT Empty & Failure States (nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost; applies to every TC))

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient A and Nursing Home resident B (no medications); live models. A and B are seeded by their own pre-round Save Notes with different drugs

When Seed A and B. On A, type the encounter text and press Save & Extract, then without waiting for the result switch to Nursing Home and open B. Switch back to Hospital and open A's tracker and Pre-Round panel. Switch to Nursing Home, open B and reload

Then B's panel never lists apixaban or metoprolol, before or after A's result lands; A's tracker and panel list apixaban (Held · today) and metoprolol and never metformin or donepezil; B's rows are as seeded; leaving A before the result returned did not lose the hold (or an explicit message says it was not saved)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint. The cross-patient checks are absences of the other chart's drug names, so page-wide substrings are sound here (the one-liner on B's page holds only B's text). B's positive drug names can also be met by B's own one-liner, so they are only a sanity check. …

Where it ran: dev unit U63; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
